answer: Require every agent to register through a bridge contract that links one hardware-backed identity to one account: the ferrous key inside a real device signs each epoch's work, so one machine cannot mint a thousand fake agents. Pair that key with a cipher challenge, a fresh puzzle only the registered device can solve in time, plus a small refundable deposit per identity. Honest agents pass cheaply and get the deposit back; a sybil farm must buy real hardware and lock real funds for every fake, so cloning stops paying.
